'''Fluffy''' was a [[Cat/Legends|cat]] who lived during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled through [[Tolea Biqua]], on [[Genarius]], to meet with [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. To get an idea of what people they were, he arranged for them to encounter a series of situations and for one of them, he had a little [[Gender/Legends|girl]] go and ask them to rescue Fluffy, who was stuck up a [[Tree/Legends|tree]].
